name: Quick Share
author: jhannesreimann
description: Send and receive files, links and text with Android phones over Google Quick Share, with fast Wi-Fi transfers even when the phone is on another network. Phones connect over Bluetooth LE without pairing; when a connection uses Bluetooth Classic instead, the daemon answers that phone's pairing request itself and removes the pairing afterwards. One click builds the background service from source (needs Rust; cargo downloads the locked crates from crates.io). Optional for laptops with one Wi-Fi card: a small Wi-Fi helper that runs as root, installed to /usr with a polkit rule that lets your session run it without a password and a udev rule that keeps NetworkManager off its interface.
